title: Tobias Engel: SS7: Locate. Track. Manipulate.
summary: Tobias Engel's 31C3 talk shows how weaknesses in the SS7 telephone signaling network let companies and attackers locate, track and manipulate phones from anywhere in the world, with precision down to about 50 meters.
why: HN cites it as the foundational demonstration that SS7 is insecure, relevant to arguments about SMS-based two-factor authentication.

quote.text: Tobias Engel demonstrates among other things tracking down a test subject over two continents for about a month
